_note: Single source for the book cards on the Book tab (/about/), the Books page (/books/) and the ad slots (ads.js). Edit here, then run: python3 tools/books_render.py. For each book set status to available once it is on sale, and paste the exact Amazon addresses into kindle and paperback. The amazon.com search addresses below are interim stand-ins until the exact product addresses are added.

books.title: Israel NOWlej
books.subtitle: Know the Story of the Jewish Land in Maps, Timelines, Charts, and Graphics
books.author: Richard J. Koret
books.desc: The visual atlas of the Jewish land. Maps, timelines, charts and graphics first, text second: 33 maps, 19 timelines, 13 infographics, 17 rankings, 6 Top Ten lists, A Taste of Israel, and a glossary and index of more than 400 entries. Every page opens online through a QR code, so the book and this site work together.
books.short: 33 maps, 19 timelines, 400+ glossary entries. The visual atlas of the Jewish land.

books.title: Israel in Maps
books.subtitle: Where, When and Why is Zion?
books.author: Richard J. Koret
books.desc: The atlas. Twenty-nine historical maps from the Patriarchs to the present, each facing a page that explains it, plus size comparisons, population charts and rankings.
books.short: Twenty-nine historical maps, each facing a page that explains it.

books.title: Israel in Time
books.subtitle: Four Thousand Years at a Glance
books.author: Richard J. Koret
books.desc: The timelines. Nineteen timelines from the patriarchs to today, Top Ten lists, reference tables, demographic charts, calendars, a This Day in History, a glossary and an index.
books.short: Nineteen timelines from the patriarchs to today.

books.title: Welcome to Zion
books.subtitle: The Land of Israel, 4,000 Years Old and 40 Miles Wide
books.author: Richard J. Koret
books.desc: A tour of ten regions and eighty-one sites, from Eilat in the south to the Gaza border. Each site has its own page, picture and short story.
books.short: A tour of ten regions and eighty-one sites.
